OpenAI launches Health in ChatGPT

Health is a new mode in which the chatbot gains access to your medical records and Apple Watch data to answer health-related questions based on your actual metrics.

Users can connect Apple Health along with medical records from hospital systems, One Medical, or Function Health. Once linked, ChatGPT can view lab results, medications, recent doctor visits, sleep, and activity data. It can compare a new blood test with previous ones, explain unclear terms from discharge summaries, or even recommend restaurants while taking allergies into account.

According to OpenAI’s own statistics, 300 million people already ask ChatGPT about health every week. Among early testers, 70% of these conversations began outside a dedicated medical section. For this reason, the relevant context is now pulled directly into regular chats without the need to switch modes.

Dedicated models have been assigned to the feature. Free users get access to GPT-5.5 Instant, which has improved recognition of situations that require a real doctor. Paid users receive GPT-5.6 Sol, which handles complex cases more accurately and explains lab results more effectively.
Data from medical records and Apple Health is not used for model training or advertising targeting. It is stored with additional encryption, can be disconnected at any time, and synchronized records are deleted within 30 days.

The feature is currently available only in the United States, on web and iOS, for users aged 18 and older on the Free, Go, Plus, and Pro plans. It is not available in Codex.

🚨 BitMEX Accused of Stealing 622 BTC — Is Another Crypto Scandal Unfolding?

BKX Services and investor David Namdar have filed a class-action lawsuit against BitMEX, accusing the exchange of improperly taking 622.66 BTC through forced liquidations. The plaintiffs claim BitMEX created conditions that triggered liquidations and transferred the remaining BTC into its insurance fund. The case is now before the court. ⚖️

The lawsuit comes as HDR Global Trading prepares to shut down the platform, with operations scheduled to end on September 23, 2026.

While the news has fueled speculation about a possible market dump, analysts note that the disputed amount is relatively small compared to Bitcoin’s overall market liquidity. BMEX reportedly fell sharply (>98%), but BTC and the broader crypto market have shown little reaction so far.

For now, this appears to be a serious legal issue for BitMEX rather than a catalyst for a broader market sell-off.

Main Points
⏺ In DeFi, the same collateral can indirectly back multiple obligations
⏺ It boosts capital efficiency but increases systemic fragility
⏺ This post explains how “leverage on top of leverage” forms

1️⃣ How It Happens — you post collateral, borrow against it, then reuse the borrowed asset as collateral elsewhere.
2️⃣ Why People Do It — yield strategies and capital efficiency: more output from the same base.
3️⃣ Where Risk Lives — a price drop can trigger cascading liquidations across layers.
4️⃣ Why It Matters — calm markets hide the links; stress markets push correlations toward 1.
5️⃣ Practical Rule — count how many collateral layers your strategy has and model a sharp drawdown.

Final Thoughts

Rehypothecation is an accelerator. It adds efficiency, but it makes systems brittle when markets break.

He also warned supporters against turning him into a hero.

"Do not make this mistake," Dipke said. "The country has already suffered from making one person a hero."

Faria Asif, 26, a lawyer attending the protest, said: "I am overjoyed. This is a huge victory—not just for students, but for the Constitution and for the entire nation. Being part of this movement has been incredibly empowering for all of us. I believe this is the beginning of real change."

News of Pradhan's resignation was met with jubilant celebrations from tens of thousands of CJP supporters gathered in Delhi, who had been demanding government accountability.

"This is one of the most historic days for our country," said 27-year-old Rochelle Cope. "For the first time in 12 years, someone in the government has been held accountable for wrongdoing. And it wasn't political parties that achieved this—it was the people.

"This is a movement of unity, love, solidarity, peace, justice, and strength. Being here has made me proud to be an Indian citizen. This is only the beginning—the government will no longer be able to rule as it did before."

For many participants, this was their first political protest, and the movement has been described as a "Gen Z political awakening" in India.

Public anger intensified following the police's violent response, prompting even more people to join the movement. Throughout the week, thousands gathered at the CJP's sit-in in Delhi, chanting anti-government slogans and demanding Pradhan's resignation.

Demonstrations also spread across the country, with hundreds of thousands taking to the streets in Kolkata and Mumbai.

Modi had agreed to fast-track investigations into the exam leak scandal but made no mention of the CJP's primary demand: Pradhan's resignation, despite him being regarded as one of the Prime Minister's most influential and loyal ministers.

However, the CJP leadership made it clear that Pradhan's resignation was a non-negotiable demand. As more protests erupted over the weekend and negotiations reached a stalemate, the BJP government appeared to be increasingly cornered.

🔔 Ethereum price faces $2,000 test as oil surge revives rate fears 

⚡️ Ethereum price has remained trapped below $2,000 as rising oil prices, renewed interest-rate concerns and BitMEX’s planned shutdown have tempered bullish sentiment despite continued spot ETF inflows. According to data from cryptonews, Ethereum price traded near $1,927 on July 23 after reaching an intraday high of $1,941. The token has recovered more than 27% from its June low near $1,514, but repeated failures around $1,955 have kept the psychological $2,000 level beyond buyers’ reach.

🔗 Rate traders have already adjusted their positions. The probability of a September Fed hike rose to 79% from 68% per data from the CME FedWatch tool. Expectations for the July meeting remain centered on no change, but another oil-led inflation increase could lift Treasury yields and pressure risk assets such as Ethereum. 

🔖 U.S. equities also weakened after Alphabet raised its 2026 capital-spending forecast to between $195 billion and $205 billion. The company recorded negative free cash flow of $5.9 billion as quarterly expenditure doubled to $44.9 billion, while its shares fell in premarket trading.
